description: This Java source file defines the IndexFactory class, a utility class for creating various types of MongoDB index objects, including default, custom, and expiration indexes, with methods to generate index configurations and handle index creation parameters.

classes.name: IndexFactory
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods to create MongoDB index instances with various configurations.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new Index with default ascending order for specified fields, optionally sparse if unique is true.

methods.name: newInstanceWithCustomKeys
methods.description: Creates a new Index with custom index keys, optionally sparse if unique is true.

methods.name: newExpirationIndex
methods.description: Creates an index for background deletion based on a timestamp field with expiration time.

methods.name: createKeysDocument
methods.description: Constructs a BsonDocument representing index keys from a list of IndexKey objects.

methods.name: createDefaultKeys
methods.description: Generates a list of default IndexKey objects from a list of field name strings.
